sentences.text: WOMAN: It's really good to see you, Tom.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 很高兴见到你，汤姆。

sentences.text: Since I had to give up work, I feel I'm losing touch with my friends and colleagues.
sentences.zh: 自从我不得不辞职以来，我觉得自己正逐渐与朋友和同事失去联系。

sentences.text: MAN: We really miss you in the office.
sentences.zh: MAN: 办公室里大家都非常想念你。

sentences.text: We were all so sorry you had to leave.
sentences.zh: 我们都很遗憾你不得不离开。

sentences.text: But you must be relieved to have more time to look after your mother.
sentences.zh: 但你一定很欣慰现在有更多时间照顾你母亲了。

sentences.text: How is she?
sentences.zh: 她最近怎么样？

sentences.text: WOMAN: Well she is very cheerful, but she needs a lot of help.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 她心情非常愉快，但需要大量帮助。

sentences.text: MAN: Have you tried to get any support from the local council?
sentences.zh: MAN: 你有没有尝试向当地议会申请任何支持？

sentences.text: WOMAN: No, I didn't know I could.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 没有，我之前并不知道我可以这么做。

sentences.text: MAN: Yes, they offer different kinds of practical support.
sentences.zh: MAN: 是的，他们提供多种实用支持。

sentences.text: They realise that carers sometimes need time for all the other responsibilities they have, apart from the person they're caring for, and also that they sometimes need a break.
sentences.zh: 他们意识到照护者有时需要腾出时间来处理除照护对象之外的其他责任，同时也意识到照护者有时也需要休息。

sentences.text: WOMAN: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 完全正确。

sentences.text: OK, so tell me more.
sentences.zh: 好的，那请再详细告诉我一些情况。

sentences.text: How do I go about getting this support?
sentences.zh: 我该如何申请这种支持呢？

sentences.text: MAN: Well, you'd have to have an assessment of your mother's needs.
sentences.zh: MAN: 首先，你需要对你母亲的需求进行一次评估。

sentences.text: That means someone would come round and talk to you about the situation and what you need.
sentences.zh: 这意味着会有人上门拜访，与你讨论当前的情况以及你的具体需求。

sentences.text: So, for a start, they'd want to know the amount of time you spend looking after your mother every day.
sentences.zh: 因此，首先他们会想了解你每天花多少时间照护你母亲。

sentences.text: WOMAN: OK.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.text: MAN: Then they'll probably ask you what sorts of tasks you do for your mother during the day.
sentences.zh: MAN: 然后他们很可能还会问你白天为你母亲做哪些事情。

sentences.text: Things like if she needs help with getting dressed, for example.
sentences.zh: 比如，她是否需要你在穿衣方面提供帮助，等等。

sentences.text: WOMAN: Right.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 明白了。

sentences.text: I help her with that.
sentences.zh: 我帮她做那件事。

sentences.text: And also I help her get into the shower in the morning.
sentences.zh: 另外，早上我还帮她进入淋浴间。

sentences.text: MAN: Yes, that sort of thing.
sentences.zh: MAN: 对，就是这类事情。

sentences.text: WOMAN: Yes, that's becoming a bit of a problem.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的，这正逐渐成为一个问题。

sentences.text: She used to be very good at it, but not anymore.
sentences.zh: 她以前在这方面做得很好，但现在不行了。

sentences.text: MAN: And be ready to tell them about anything you find particularly difficult about caring for your mother.
sentences.zh: MAN: 并准备好向他们说明你在照顾母亲过程中遇到的任何特别困难之处。

sentences.text: WOMAN: So, recently I've noticed she's started to have quite bad problems with her memory.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 所以，最近我注意到她的记忆力开始出现相当严重的问题。

sentences.text: If I wasn't there, I think she'd forget to eat, for example.
sentences.zh: 如果我不在那儿，我想她甚至会忘记吃饭，例如。

sentences.text: And often she doesn't seem quite sure what day it is.
sentences.zh: 而且她常常不太确定今天是星期几。

sentences.text: MAN: Yes, tell them about that.
sentences.zh: MAN: 是的，把这一点告诉他们。

sentences.text: And are there any physical difficulties you have caring for her?
sentences.zh: 你在照顾她时是否存在任何身体上的困难？

sentences.text: Lifting her, for example?
sentences.zh: 比如抱起她？

sentences.text: WOMAN: Yes, she's quite heavy and I'm afraid of hurting my back.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的，她体重很重，我担心会伤到自己的背部。

sentences.text: I'd be in real trouble if that happened.
sentences.zh: 如果真发生这种情况，我可就麻烦大了。

sentences.text: MAN: They can give you advice about that and also about how to avoid the possibility of your mum having a fall.
sentences.zh: MAN: 他们可以就此给你提供建议，同时也会就如何避免你母亲跌倒提供指导。

sentences.text: WOMAN: Great.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 太好了。

sentences.text: So once they've done this assessment, if I'm eligible, what happens next?
sentences.zh: 那么，等他们完成这项评估后，如果我符合条件，接下来会发生什么？

sentences.text: MAN: Well, they might support you financially.
sentences.zh: MAN: 嗯，他们可能会在经济上给予你支持。

sentences.text: So they might help you with transport costs, like if you have to get a taxi to take your mother for an appointment, for example.
sentences.zh: 例如，他们可能帮你承担交通费用——比如你必须打出租车带母亲去就诊时。

sentences.text: WOMAN: I usually drive her myself, actually.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 实际上，我通常都是自己开车送她。

sentences.text: So, could I claim the petrol?
sentences.zh: 那么，我可以报销汽油费吗？

sentences.text: MAN: You could.
sentences.zh: MAN: 你可以。

sentences.text: And you can claim for the insurance too.
sentences.zh: 而且你也可以报销保险费用。

sentences.text: WOMAN: Oh, right.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哦，好的。

sentences.text: MAN: And if you need help with the housework, they can arrange for someone to come along once or twice a week.
sentences.zh: MAN: 如果你在家务方面需要帮助，他们可以安排人每周来一两次。

sentences.text: And one other thing.
sentences.zh: 还有一件事。

sentences.text: I hope you don't mind me saying this, but it important you look after yourself And it seems to me you under quite a bit of stress
sentences.zh: 我希望你不介意我这么说，但你照顾好自己非常重要；在我看来，你承受的压力相当大。

sentences.text: WOMAN: I am yes
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.text: MAN: Well tell the council because they may be able to give you some advice on how to minimise it
sentences.zh: MAN: 那么请告诉地方议会，因为他们或许能为你提供一些减轻压力的建议。

sentences.text: WOMAN: Really?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 真的吗？

sentences.text: Though, actually, I feel so much better having talked to you.
sentences.zh: 不过，实际上，和你聊过之后，我感觉好多了。

sentences.text: I'll get in touch with the council straight away.
sentences.zh: 我马上就会联系地方议会。

sentences.text: Now, shall we go for coffee or something?
sentences.zh: 现在，我们去喝杯咖啡之类的东西怎么样？

sentences.text: Good morning everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家早上好。

sentences.text: I'm Steve Wainwright from Elmley Town Council and I organise the town's volunteer scheme.
sentences.zh: 我是埃尔姆利镇议会的史蒂夫·韦恩莱特，负责组织本镇的志愿者计划。

sentences.text: I'm delighted you're all interested in joining the scheme.
sentences.zh: 很高兴看到各位对加入该计划感兴趣。

sentences.text: Our volunteers help to create a sense of community among the man: y people who live in our historic town of Elmley and make residents and visitors feel welcome at local events.
sentences.zh: 我们的志愿者帮助在历史悠久的埃尔姆利镇众多居民中营造社区感，并让当地活动中的居民和游客感到宾至如归。

sentences.text: First, I'll mention just a few of the activities that volunteers carry out.
sentences.zh: 首先，我仅简要介绍志愿者开展的一些活动。

sentences.text: One is to walk around the town centre streets wearing our volunteer T -shirt.
sentences.zh: 其中一项是穿着我们的志愿者T恤，在镇中心街道上巡视。

sentences.text: Tourists often ask how to get to a particular shop, and they might also be grateful for recommendations about what to visit.
sentences.zh: 游客经常询问如何前往某家特定商店，他们也可能很感激您推荐值得参观的景点。

sentences.text: The town holds a large number of concerts each year and part of the volunteers' role is to get everyone in the audience to the right place as smoothly as possible.
sentences.zh: 本镇每年举办大量音乐会，志愿者的部分职责就是确保所有观众尽可能顺畅地抵达各自座位。

sentences.text: You'd be surprised how man: y people buy tickets, then don't check them, and head for the wrong section of the hall.
sentences.zh: 您会惊讶于许多人买了票后却不核对票面信息，结果走错了音乐厅的区域。

sentences.text: Volunteers may get involved with community groups, such as sports clubs or gardeners' associations.
sentences.zh: 志愿者还可参与各类社区团体，例如体育俱乐部或园艺协会。

sentences.text: Here, the volunteers talk about how groups can help each other.
sentences.zh: 在此，志愿者们探讨各团体如何相互支持。

sentences.text: For instance, a writing group might want to travel to another town to hear a talk by a well - known author, but may not know that another club has a coach they could travel in.
sentences.zh: 例如，一个写作小组可能希望前往另一座城镇聆听一位知名作家的讲座，却不知另一家俱乐部恰好拥有一辆可供使用的长途客车。

sentences.text: The town produces a monthly magazine, and anyone who lives in the town can send in articles.
sentences.zh: 本镇每月出版一份杂志，凡居住在本镇者均可投稿。

sentences.text: It's free to residents and is paid for by local businesses.
sentences.zh: 该杂志向居民免费发放，经费由本地企业赞助。

sentences.text: That's the responsibility of the council's advertising department we depend on volunteers though to find out what people think of events they've attended and any suggestions they have for the future the volunteers then send a summary to the editors there are a number of clubs for retired people and every year the council arranges lunch for all the members the volunteers welcome the guests and when everyone's sitting down and relaxing after the meal, some volunteers put on a show.
sentences.zh: 这属于议会广告部门的职责；不过，我们依赖志愿者去了解人们对其所参加活动的看法，以及对未来活动的建议；随后，志愿者将汇总意见提交给编辑。本镇设有多个面向退休人士的俱乐部，议会每年为所有会员安排一次午餐；志愿者负责迎接宾客，待所有人落座用餐并放松休息后，部分志愿者还会进行表演。

sentences.text: Usually around half an hour of songs and short plays, the club members really welcome the chance to chat to the volunteers at these events.
sentences.zh: 通常是一场约半小时的歌曲与短剧演出；俱乐部成员非常欢迎借此机会与志愿者交流。

sentences.text: OK, now you know some of the things our volunteers do, I'll go on to some practical matters.
sentences.zh: 好的，现在大家已了解我们志愿者的部分工作内容，接下来我将介绍一些实际事项。

sentences.text: As you probably know, the town arranges three major festivals every year, and they all depend on a large number of volunteers.
sentences.zh: 各位可能知道，本镇每年举办三大重要节日，而这些活动均需大量志愿者支持。

sentences.text: The book festival lasts three days, and uses several venues which all need volunteers.
sentences.zh: 图书节为期三天，使用多个场地，每个场地都需要志愿者。

sentences.text: More are needed for the music festival because that lasts a whole week, and even more help is required for the science festival, even though it's only two days long.
sentences.zh: 音乐节持续整整一周，所需志愿者人数更多；尽管科学节仅有两天，但所需协助人数甚至更多。

sentences.text: It involves quite a lot of venues, though.
sentences.zh: 尽管它涉及相当多的场地。

sentences.text: It's a good idea to help at the festival you're most interested in, because you can attend most of the events for free.
sentences.zh: 帮助你最感兴趣的节日是个好主意，因为你可以免费参加大部分活动。

sentences.text: We try to use volunteers who are flexible, though, because some festival events are held outdoors and the weather may affect the size of the audience and even whether the event can take place so there can be changes at short notice What essential though is being able to get on well with other people and also to deal with someone who's behaving badly, as occasionally happens.
sentences.zh: 不过，我们尽量使用灵活的志愿者，因为一些节日活动在户外举行，天气可能会影响观众人数，甚至影响活动能否如期举行，因此可能会有临时变动。但最重要的是，要能与他人融洽相处，还要能妥善处理行为不当的人，这种情况偶尔会发生。

sentences.text: Our plan is to get you all working in September, after a week's training starting on the 2nd, so we'll be timetabling you for duties the following week from the 9th onward.
sentences.zh: 我们的计划是在经过从9月2日开始为期一周的培训后，于9月份安排大家正式上岗，因此从9月9日起将为您排班安排工作。

sentences.text: Later in the week beginning September 23rd we have a chat with each of you to find out how you feel about being a volunteer and what extra support you need.
sentences.zh: 在9月23日当周的晚些时候，我们会与每位志愿者进行一次交流，了解您对志愿工作的感受以及您需要哪些额外支持。

sentences.text: As a thank you to the volunteers we arrange an annual event.
sentences.zh: 作为对志愿者的感谢，我们会每年组织一次特别活动。

sentences.text: In recent years we've had a party in the Town Hall and last year a barbecue in Chamber Park.
sentences.zh: 近年来，我们曾在市政厅举办过派对，去年则在钱伯斯公园举行了烧烤活动。

sentences.text: Our forthcoming event is a trip along the canal from here to Dewhurst and back.
sentences.zh: 我们即将举办的活动是一次乘船沿运河从这里前往德赫斯特再返回的行程。

sentences.text: It's on Saturday, September the 28th.
sentences.zh: 活动时间为9月28日（星期六）。

sentences.text: And if you'd like to attend, you can sign up once you start work.
sentences.zh: 如果您希望参加，可以在开始工作后报名。

sentences.text: Now, this is the Volunteer's T-shirt.
sentences.zh: 现在，这是志愿者T恤。

sentences.text: ROSIE: Colin, I'm really struggling to think of a topic for our human geography assignment.
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 科林，我实在想不出我们人文地理学作业的主题。

sentences.text: COLIN: Me too, Rosie.
sentences.zh: COLIN: 我也是，罗茜。

sentences.text: I'll tell you what, let's think about the different aspects of human geography and see if we can narrow the topic down a bit to help us decide.
sentences.zh: 我有个主意，咱们先想想人文地理学的不同方面，看看能不能把主题范围缩小一点，以便做出决定。

sentences.text: ROSIE: OK.
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 好啊。

sentences.text: So one aspect is population.
sentences.zh: 比如其中一个方面是人口。

sentences.text: That would be all about population density and migration and so on.
sentences.zh: 这主要涉及人口密度、人口迁移等等。

sentences.text: Lots of facts and statistics.
sentences.zh: 会有很多事实和统计数据。

sentences.text: Maybe a bit boring?
sentences.zh: 也许有点枯燥？

sentences.text: COLIN: Yeah, but quite straightforward to find on the internet.
sentences.zh: COLIN: 是啊，但在网上找起来倒是很直接明了。

sentences.text: ROSIE: Suppose so.
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 也许吧。

sentences.text: How about health?
sentences.zh: 那健康呢？

sentences.text: I'd never thought about the links between that and geography until Professor Lee gave us that lecture on cholera.
sentences.zh: 直到李教授给我们讲了霍乱那场讲座之前，我从没想过健康与地理之间还有这种联系。

sentences.text: How in the 19th century, a physician used street plans and plans of water supplies to find the source of a cholera epidemic.
sentences.zh: 比如19世纪一位医生曾利用街道地图和供水系统图，找到了霍乱疫情的源头。

sentences.text: COLIN: Yes, fascinating, wasn't it?
sentences.zh: COLIN: 没错，真令人着迷，对吧？

sentences.text: Or we could do something more general like economies
sentences.zh: 或者我们也可以选个更宽泛些的主题，比如经济。

sentences.text: ROSIE: So how financial and commercial factors are linked to the physical environment
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 就是探讨金融和商业因素如何与自然环境相关联。

sentences.text: COLIN: Yeah
sentences.zh: COLIN: 对。

sentences.text: ROSIE: I thought that had been taken off the syllabus for this year
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 我以为这个主题今年已从教学大纲中删去了。

sentences.text: COLIN: Has it
sentences.zh: COLIN: 真删了吗？

sentences.text: ROSIE: I not sure but it might be best to avoid it
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 我不太确定，但或许最好还是避开它。

sentences.text: COLIN: OK.
sentences.zh: COLIN: 好的。

sentences.text: Maybe we could do something on culture.
sentences.zh: 也许我们可以做关于文化方面的内容。

sentences.text: We had that lecture about culture and geography last week.
sentences.zh: 我们上周听了关于文化和地理的讲座。

sentences.text: ROSIE: I didn't get much out of that.
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 我从那场讲座中收获甚微。

sentences.text: It was all so general and the lecturer didn't give any useful examples.
sentences.zh: 内容太过笼统，而且讲师没有给出任何有用的实例。

sentences.text: COLIN: Yeah, I hardly took any notes.
sentences.zh: COLIN: 是啊，我几乎没记什么笔记。

sentences.text: It didn't seem worth it.
sentences.zh: 感觉不值得花时间。

sentences.text: ROSIE: Me neither.
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 我也是。

sentences.text: COLIN: We could focus on poverty.
sentences.zh: COLIN: 我们可以聚焦于贫困问题。

sentences.text: That's something that's a global problem.
sentences.zh: 这是一个全球性的问题。

sentences.text: ROSIE: The trouble is, Dr Lee was saying, that you have to be careful with some of the figures relating to poverty.
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 麻烦在于，李博士曾提到，你必须谨慎对待一些与贫困相关的数据。

sentences.text: They're sometimes deliberately man: ipulated.
sentences.zh: 这些数据有时是被刻意操纵的。

sentences.text: COLIN: You mean the information gets changed for political reasons?
sentences.zh: COLIN: 你的意思是，信息会出于政治原因而被篡改？

sentences.text: ROSIE: That sort of thing, yes.
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 没错，就是这类情况。

sentences.text: ROSIE: So what are we going to do our assignment on?
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 那么我们的作业到底要写什么主题呢？

sentences.text: I'll tell you what.
sentences.zh: 我有个主意。

sentences.text: One of the possibilities we have discussed is urbanisation and now over half the world population lives in cities.
sentences.zh: 我们之前讨论过的可能性之一是城市化——目前全球超过一半的人口居住在城市中。

sentences.text: That really important
sentences.zh: 这确实非常重要。

sentences.text: COLIN: OK good idea Rosie: Let do that
sentences.zh: COLIN: 好主意，罗茜！我们就选这个吧。

sentences.text: ROSIE: I love living in a big city but of course there are problems
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 我很喜欢住在大城市，但当然也存在一些问题。

sentences.text: COLIN: Things like theft and robbery?
sentences.zh: COLIN: 像盗窃和抢劫这类事情？

sentences.text: ROSIE: Yes, but where I come from, that's linked to another more serious issue, which is that a lot of people don't have jobs.
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 是的，但在我的家乡，这与另一个更严重的问题相关联，即很多人没有工作。

sentences.text: That's getting worse and worse.
sentences.zh: 这种情况正变得越来越糟。

sentences.text: And we also still have quite a lot of people who are homeless, though that's not quite so bad as it was.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们仍然有相当多的无家可归者，尽管这一状况已不像过去那么严重了。

sentences.text: COLIN: It would be nice to talk about some positive dev: elopments, like some of the new dev: elopments on the outskirts of cities.
sentences.zh: COLIN: 谈谈一些积极的发展情况会很不错，比如城市郊区的一些新开发项目。

sentences.text: ROSIE: Yeah, they've opened some massive new shopping centres outside my city.
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 是的，他们在我所在的城市郊外新建了一些超大型购物中心。

sentences.text: COLIN: Yeah, the same with mine, but it means a lot of the shops in the city centre are closing down.
sentences.zh: COLIN: 是的，我的城市也是如此，但这意味着市中心的许多商店正在陆续关闭。

sentences.text: But the outskirts are ideal for buildings that need a lot of space, like for conferences.
sentences.zh: 不过，郊区非常适合建造需要大量空间的建筑，比如会议中心。

sentences.text: They've opened a couple of big ones.
sentences.zh: 他们已经建成了几家大型会议中心。

sentences.text: ROSIE: Yes, we've got some too.
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 是的，我们那里也有一些。

sentences.text: It'd be nicer to have more facilities for things like football too, but that's not happening where I live.
sentences.zh: 要是能多建一些足球等运动设施就更好了，但在我住的地方，这并未发生。

sentences.text: COLIN: Same in my area.
sentences.zh: COLIN: 我所在的地区情况也一样。

sentences.text: ROSIE: We could include something about dev: eloping disused industrial sites.
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 我们还可以提一提对废弃工业用地的再开发。

sentences.text: It seems like a good idea because you're not doing any harm to the natural environment.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是个好主意，因为这样做不会对自然环境造成任何损害。

sentences.text: COLIN: Yeah, but aren't the buildings architecturally significant?
sentences.zh: COLIN: 是啊，但那些建筑在建筑学上不是具有重要意义吗？

sentences.text: ROSIE: Not really.
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 并不 really（实际上）如此。

sentences.text: And what people forget is that they often used quite dangerous materials, chemicals and things, which haven't been properly cleared away, so the whole site has to be made safe.
sentences.zh: 而人们往往忘记的是，这些旧厂房曾使用过相当危险的材料，比如化学品等，而这些危险物质并未得到妥善清除，因此整个场地都必须进行安全处理。

sentences.text: COLIN: Hmm, that can't be cheap.
sentences.zh: COLIN: 嗯，这肯定不便宜。

sentences.text: And I bet it's often not budgeted for.
sentences.zh: 而且我敢打赌，这类开支常常未被纳入预算。

sentences.text: ROSIE: You're right.
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 您说得对。

sentences.text: COLIN: Have you read about Masdar City?
sentences.zh: COLIN: 你读过关于马斯达尔城的报道吗？

sentences.text: ROSIE: In Abu Dhabi?
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 在阿布扎比？

sentences.text: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.text: It was designed to be a green city, wasn't it?
sentences.zh: 它原本的设计目标是一座绿色城市，对吧？

sentences.text: That might be a good example of a city which set out to depend entirely on renewable energy.
sentences.zh: 这或许是一个很好的范例，即一座从一开始就立志完全依赖可再生能源的城市。

sentences.text: COLIN: Yes we should say something about that It was designed to be totally pedestrianised too wasn't it with the transport underground
sentences.zh: COLIN: 没错，我们应当提一下这一点。它当初的设计还旨在实现彻底的无车化，对吧？交通系统全部设于地下。

sentences.text: ROSIE: Yes and they had big plans for recycling to reduce waste to the lowest possible level But let's stick to talking about power sources.
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 是的，而且他们曾制定了宏大的回收利用计划，以将废弃物减至最低水平。不过，咱们还是聚焦在能源来源上吧。

sentences.text: COLIN: Then there's that ecotown in England, Greenhill Abbotts.
sentences.zh: COLIN: 还有英国那个生态小镇——格林希尔·阿博茨。

sentences.text: It set out to conform to the usual principles, sustainability and so on.
sentences.zh: 它最初的目标是遵循常规的可持续发展等原则。

sentences.text: A lot of people were against it at first.
sentences.zh: 起初，许多人对此表示反对。

sentences.text: They said the plans were unrealistic.
sentences.zh: 他们称这些规划不切实际。

sentences.text: I'm not sure how far they've got with it.
sentences.zh: 我不太确定该项目目前进展到了什么程度。

sentences.text: I'll check.
sentences.zh: 我会去查证一下。

sentences.text: ROSIE: Right.
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 好的。

sentences.text: So it looks as if we have a sort of plan.
sentences.zh: 看来我们已大致拟定了一个方案。

sentences.text: There are trends in food much as there are trends in clothing.
sentences.zh: 食品领域和服装领域一样，也存在潮流趋势。

sentences.text: Interest in food fashions has risen rapidly since the birth of the smartphone when people first began taking photos of their food and instantly sharing them with their friends.
sentences.zh: 自智能手机问世以来，人们对美食时尚的兴趣迅速上升，因为人们开始拍摄自己的食物照片，并即时与朋友分享。

sentences.text: The food industry in the UK in particular is obsessed with finding and exploiting the next big food trend.
sentences.zh: 尤其是英国的食品行业，痴迷于寻找并利用下一个重大的食品潮流。

sentences.text: Marketeers aim to create a huge demand for a food item which was previously unknown or not needed.
sentences.zh: 营销人员旨在为一种此前鲜为人知或并不需要的食品制造巨大的需求。

sentences.text: One of the most effective ways of promoting a new food product is by using social media influencers as brand ambassadors In return for free samples man: y influencers will post content about a product although there are influencers with hundreds of thousands of followers who can command large fees for their services Companies which sell vegan produce were pioneers in being able to increase sales really quickly in this way.
sentences.zh: 推广一种新型食品最有效的方式之一，是利用社交媒体网红作为品牌大使；作为免费样品的回报，这些网红会发布有关该产品的相关内容；尽管如此，仍有一些拥有数十万粉丝的网红，能为其服务收取高额费用；销售纯素食产品的公司是最早通过这种方式快速提升销量的先行者。

sentences.text: For a food item to become really popular, it has to be readily available.
sentences.zh: 一种食品要想真正流行起来，必须易于获取。

sentences.text: So supermarkets have a role to play in creating a new food trend.
sentences.zh: 因此，超市在创造新的食品潮流方面也发挥着重要作用。

sentences.text: They have dedicated teams closely following which new products or ingredients are trending on social media and are particularly interested in what well-known chefs are putting on their menus.
sentences.zh: 它们设有专门团队，密切关注哪些新产品或新食材正在社交媒体上走红，并尤其关注知名厨师们将其列入菜单的情况。

sentences.text: I'd like to look at a few examples of marketing campaigns which were really successful in launching a new fashion trend.
sentences.zh: 我想举几个营销活动的成功案例，这些活动成功地推出了新的食品潮流。

sentences.text: Starting in the 1990s with the avocado.
sentences.zh: 首先从20世纪90年代的牛油果说起。

sentences.text: A British PR company was hired to raise its profile and stimulate demand.
sentences.zh: 一家英国公关公司受雇提升牛油果的知名度并刺激市场需求。

sentences.text: They paid for a group of journalists to travel out to South Africa to meet avocado farmers.
sentences.zh: 该公司出资安排一群记者前往南非，拜访牛油果种植农户。

sentences.text: Articles written following this visit helped to educate the British public about the avocado, which at this time was certainly not the daily staple it's since become.
sentences.zh: 此次访问后撰写的报道帮助英国公众了解了牛油果——当时它远非如今这般成为日常必备品。

sentences.text: Advertisements were designed to promote the avocado as a superfood, rich in nutrients and therefore beneficial for health.
sentences.zh: 广告设计将牛油果宣传为富含营养的超级食品，因而有益健康。

sentences.text: Avocados became hugely fashionable, and within a few years UK avocado sales had grown from £13 million annually to around £150 million, making it one of the most successful fresh produce campaigns in UK history.
sentences.zh: 牛油果迅速风靡一时，短短几年内，英国牛油果年销售额便从1300万英镑飙升至约1.5亿英镑，使其成为英国历史上最成功的生鲜产品营销活动之一。

sentences.text: Oat milk is a recent example of a new product which became fashionable very quickly.
sentences.zh: 燕麦奶是近期一个迅速走红的新产品实例。

sentences.text: Now there are man: y brands available but one company which had early success was the Swedish brand Oatly They attracted a lot of attention with a media campaign which used provocation as a way of getting their message across effectively.
sentences.zh: 如今市面上已有众多品牌，但早期取得成功的一家公司是瑞典品牌Oatly；他们通过一场以挑衅为策略的媒体宣传活动吸引了大量关注，从而高效传达了品牌信息。

sentences.text: The fact that this campaign aggravated competitors producing milk from dairy cows was seen as a plus, as it helped to make oat milk seem cool.
sentences.zh: 这场宣传活动激怒了以奶牛产奶为原料的竞争品牌，这一事实反而被视为优势，因为它让燕麦奶显得更酷。

sentences.text: In the USA, the brand decided against a big retail launch in favour of getting the product into coffee chains, which removed the need for a big advertising budget.
sentences.zh: 在美国，该品牌决定不采取大规模零售渠道首发策略，而是选择先进入咖啡连锁店，从而避免了巨额广告预算的投入。

sentences.text: This proved far more effective than offering samples in supermarkets.
sentences.zh: 实践证明，此举比在超市提供试吃样品要有效得多。

sentences.text: Oat milk had an advantage over other alternative milk products, such as almond milk.
sentences.zh: 燕麦奶相比其他植物奶（例如杏仁奶）具有优势。

sentences.text: Man: y consumers prefer it because it has less of an impact on the environment.
sentences.zh: 男：消费者更青睐它，是因为它对环境的影响更小。

sentences.text: It requires significantly less water to produce than other alternative milk products and it also has a relatively low carbon footprint.
sentences.zh: 与其它植物奶相比，燕麦奶的生产所需用水量显著减少，且其碳足迹也相对较低。

sentences.text: Norwegian scray, a rarely available seasonal fish delicacy, otherwise known as Arctic cod, is now found on the menus of Michelin - starred restaurants throughout Europe.
sentences.zh: 挪威斯克雷鱼是一种极为稀有、仅在特定季节捕获的珍馐鱼类，亦称北极鳕鱼，如今已出现在欧洲多家米其林星级餐厅的菜单上。

sentences.text: The demand for Skre has been used by a food marketing agency to build the reputation of Norway's fisheries in general.
sentences.zh: 斯克雷鱼日益增长的需求已被一家食品营销机构用以整体提升挪威渔业的声誉。

sentences.text: Marketing surveys have shown that a significant number of shoppers now associate Norway with excellent seafood.
sentences.zh: 市场营销调查显示，目前有相当数量的购物者已将挪威与优质海产品联系在一起。

sentences.text: Food trends can be considered a good thing in some ways, as they can benefit farmers and food producers enormously.
sentences.zh: 从某些方面来看，食品潮流可被视为一件好事，因为它能极大惠及农民和食品生产商。

sentences.text: The public can also be encouraged to buy things which are more sustainably produced.
sentences.zh: 公众亦可被鼓励购买那些以更可持续方式生产的产品。

sentences.text: But ethical concerns have been raised about the effects a surge in demand can cause.
sentences.zh: 但需求激增所引发的种种影响，已引发诸多伦理方面的担忧。

sentences.text: Quinoa is a classic example.
sentences.zh: 藜麦便是一个典型例子。

sentences.text: This plant is native to Peru and when demand peaked some years ago the price soared making it unaffordable for local people.
sentences.zh: 这种植物原产于秘鲁；数年前需求达到高峰时，其价格飙升，致使当地民众无力负担。

sentences.text: While the popularity of quinoa has benefited farmers financially there have been other negative consequences.
sentences.zh: 尽管藜麦走红为农民带来了可观的经济收益，却也带来了一系列负面后果。

sentences.text: As demand grew, farmers began working the land all year round in order to produce more quinoa.
sentences.zh: 随着需求增长，农民开始全年无休地耕作土地，以扩大藜麦产量。

sentences.text: One issue has been that the fertility of the soil decreased dramatically. which could potentially lead to desertification in some areas.
sentences.zh: 其中一个问题是土壤肥力急剧下降，这在某些地区甚至可能引发荒漠化。

sentences.text: Another example would be the case of...
sentences.zh: 另一个例子则是……
